description: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
One bounded positive head-yaw turn and return, not a full spin.
Resume small knee pulses and sways.
One bounded negative head-yaw turn and return, not a full spin.
Gentle knee pulses and sways; bounded head turns at the source spin windows replace full spins. No fast footwork or arm choreography.
Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
